description: This file implements the TraceControl plugin's core logic, including registration of RPC endpoints, tracing state translation, and handling of status and set requests for trace configurations within a C++ project.

classes.name: TraceControl
classes.description: A class responsible for managing trace control functions such as retrieving status and setting trace states, within the WPEFramework plugin namespace.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers RPC endpoints 'status' and 'set' for the trace control functionality.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters all previously registered RPC endpoints.

methods.name: TranslateState
methods.description: Converts internal trace state enumeration to JSON data enum for external representation.

methods.name: endpoint_status
methods.description: Handles the 'status' RPC call, returning current trace configuration and states filtered by module and category if specified.

methods.name: endpoint_set
methods.description: Handles the 'set' RPC call, updating trace states for a specific module and category.
